jobs.title: Project Manager, Service Delivery
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager, Service Delivery based in Brazil .

As a Project Manager within the Service Delivery team, you will take ownership of business customer orders from initiation through successful completion, creating a seamless delivery experience with fewer departmental handoffs. You will coordinate internal teams and third-party providers while keeping customers informed throughout the project lifecycle. The role combines hands-on telecommunications expertise with structured project management and customer-facing communication. You will oversee services including Internet circuits, Hosted VoIP, number porting, and SD-WAN implementations. Success requires strong organization, clear documentation, and the ability to manage multiple dependencies and priorities. This is a 100% remote opportunity in a fast-growing, innovation-focused environment where your work can directly influence customer outcomes.

Accountabilities

Own and manage the full delivery lifecycle for assigned business customer orders, ensuring timely, accurate, and high-quality completion.
Coordinate internal teams and contracted third-party resources to meet customer requirements, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
Maintain consistent, proactive communication with customers throughout the delivery process, providing clear updates and managing expectations.
Manage telecommunications delivery activities including Internet circuit ordering, Hosted VoIP projects, and number porting.
Lead SD-WAN implementation activities and coordinate VoIP porting and Internet circuit orders across multiple carriers.
Document project dependencies, priorities, requirements, and key actions to support efficient execution.
Apply hands-on service delivery experience to identify issues, coordinate solutions, and drive successful project outcomes.
Take on additional projects and responsibilities as needed to support team and organizational objectives.

Requirements

Minimum of 5 years of experience in the telecommunications industry.
At least 5 years of experience in Service Delivery and/or Project Management.
Hands-on experience with VoIP, SD-WAN implementation, and Internet circuit ordering through telecommunications carriers.
Strong ability to identify and clearly document project dependencies, priorities, and requirements.
Proven ability to coordinate and effectively manage third-party resources.
Strong project organization, communication, and customer relationship management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and delivery timelines in a fast-paced environment.
Practical, hands-on approach to resolving delivery challenges and driving projects through completion.

100% remote work environment.
Opportunity to grow within a high-growth organization.
Innovative environment that encourages ideas, initiative, and strategic thinking.
Opportunity to make a tangible impact on customer and business outcomes.
Flexible time off.
Team events and company activities.
Employee referral bonus opportunities.
Exposure to telecommunications, SD-WAN, VoIP, Internet connectivity, and service delivery projects.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About The Company

OneIT Pty Ltd is an Australia-based provider of custom software solutions dedicated to delivering bespoke software applications tailored to meet the unique needs of Australian businesses. Our organization prides itself on leveraging innovative technology and a client-centric approach to drive digital transformation across various industries. As a remote-first company, we operate with a global team of professionals committed to excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Our focus on quality, agility, and customer satisfaction has established us as a trusted partner for organizations seeking tailored software development services.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager with 4 to 6 years of proven expertise in managing complex software projects. This role involves overseeing multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery from initiation through planning, execution, user acceptance testing, go-live, and post-launch support. The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating cross-functional teams, managing project scopes, schedules, resources, and risks, and maintaining high standards of communication and documentation. This position offers an exciting opportunity to lead diverse projects in a dynamic environment, working remotely with a talented global team. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, proactive, confident in decision-making, and capable of working independently while supporting junior project managers and fostering a collaborative team culture.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess 4 to 6 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within the custom software development or IT services sectors. They should have a strong background in managing multiple projects concurrently, demonstrating excellent planning, organizational, and coordination skills. A solid understanding of project management methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall, along with experience working with cross-disciplinary teams including developers, business analysts, QA specialists, and account managers, is essential. Candidates must be comfortable working with remote and distributed teams, demonstrating strong communication and interpersonal skills. Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications (CSM, PSM, PMI-ACP) are highly desirable. A proactive approach, problem-solving mindset, and the ability to adapt to fast-paced, changing environments are critical for success in this role.

Responsibilities

Plan and manage multiple concurrent custom software projects from inception through to go-live and post-launch support, ensuring alignment with client requirements and organizational standards.
Oversee ongoing support projects alongside new project delivery, ensuring seamless integration and customer satisfaction.
Create, maintain, and update detailed project schedules, priorities, resource allocations, and delivery plans to meet project objectives and deadlines.
Coordinate efforts among developers, business analysts, QA teams, and other stakeholders to ensure project tasks are progressing according to plan.
Monitor project progress, identify risks, resolve blockers, manage dependencies, and optimize resource utilization to maintain project momentum.
Make informed, timely decisions to address project challenges and keep deliverables on track, escalating issues when necessary.
Collaborate effectively with remote, distributed teams, fostering a results-driven and sustainable work environment.
Manage project tickets, including prioritization, assignment, status updates, and billing processes, ensuring transparency and accountability.
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), production releases, and post-go-live activities to ensure smooth transitions and operational stability.
Prepare comprehensive project status reports, maintain accurate documentation, and communicate progress to stakeholders regularly.
Support and mentor Junior and Associate Project Managers, sharing best practices and guiding their professional development.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of project management processes, templates, and workflows, integrating AI tools and automation to enhance efficiency.

Benefits

OneIT Pty Ltd offers a full-time remote working environment, providing flexibility and work-life balance. Join a diverse and talented team working across the globe, gaining exposure to a variety of industries and innovative projects. We prioritize professional growth by offering comprehensive training, career development opportunities, and a supportive culture that encourages continuous learning. Our competitive compensation packages and benefits aim to attract and retain top talent, fostering a motivating and rewarding work environment. As part of our team, you will enjoy the benefits of working in a forward-thinking organization committed to your success and well-being.

Equal Opportunity

OneIT Pty Ltd is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or cultural identity. We believe that diversity enhances our team’s creativity, innovation, and effectiveness, and we are dedicated to fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

Do you want to help Akamai build a fast, intelligent, and secure network operating on the edge?

Would supporting the biggest global network excite you?

Join our Supply Chain Management Team

We provide support for Akamai's global Infrastructure teams so they can deploy and maintain the networks that power Akamai products and services. Our primary responsibility is management of hardware procurement and distribution. On the Server Procurement team, we focus on planning, buying, and all-inclusive asset management of network servers.

Partner with the best

In this role, you will work closely with external parties such as Server Manufacturers, 3PLs, Carriers, Repair Vendors, as well as with many internal stakeholders on teams in Cloud Technology Group and Finance group.

As a Supply Chain Project Manager, you will be responsible for:

Maintaining the procurement relationship with server vendors, providing feedback for vendor scorecards and participating in quarterly business reviews.
Participating in cross-functional meetings to understand strategies and aligning procurement decisions with short-term and long-term objectives.
Collaborating with Engineering, Design, Program Management, and Planning to integrate new products and technologies while managing roadmap risk and outdated inventory.
Addressing material shortages and unexpected conditions while collaborating with business groups to understand component roles and impacts of delays.
Monitoring pending deployments and suggesting inter-warehouse transfers, project sequencing, and equipment substitutions to optimize timeliness and overall deployment costs.
Demonstrating urgency in researching, tracking, and resolving supply issues efficiently by collaborating with vendors for timely, cost-effective solutions.

Do What You Love

To be successful in this role you will:

Have 2+ years of experience in forecasting/procurement and a High School Diploma or a Bachelor's Degree in a related field
Utilize tools like Oracle, Siebel, Tableau, Anaplan, and SQL commonly employed at Akamai for various operational tasks.
Show Project and Vendor Management experience
Demonstrate exceptional analytical abilities in both financial and operational contexts.
Perform detailed tasks independently with precision and accuracy, ensuring exceptional outcomes in all responsibilities undertaken.
Demonstrate exceptional interpersonal, negotiation, and intercultural communication abilities in both written and verbal formats effectively and professionally.

We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

Security
: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.

AI

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai:
We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Vantor is currently seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead the Kestrel and FALCON efforts. This role can be performed remotely within the continental United States.

As a Senior Program Manager, you will own overall program execution across customer engagement, financial performance, personnel management, deliverables, schedule, risk, and technical delivery. Your work will have a direct impact on supporting mission partners through software, data science, analytics, and mission-focused capability development.

In this role, you will serve as the primary program leader for a cross-functional team of approximately 12-16 team members, including software engineers, data scientists, systems engineers, and mission-focused technical staff. You will work closely with customer stakeholders, internal leadership, contracts, finance, recruiting, and delivery teams to ensure Kestrel and FALCON are executed with transparency, accountability, and strong mission alignment.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning end-to-end execution of the Falcon program, including customer engagement, CPFF contract execution, financial performance, staffing, personnel management, technical delivery, deliverables, schedule, risk, and issue management. You will lead a multidisciplinary team supporting software engineering, data science, analytics, and mission-focused capability development, while maintaining close alignment with customer priorities and internal business objectives.

You will be heavily involved in customer-facing engagements, including regular status meetings, technical discussions, program reviews, deliverable reviews, planning sessions, and executive-level updates. You will be expected to translate between mission needs, technical implementation, contractual requirements, and business execution to ensure the team delivers meaningful outcomes while maintaining a strong customer partnership.

Responsibilities

Serve as the primary Program Manager responsible for overall Kestrel and FALCON execution, performance, delivery, and customer satisfaction.
Lead, coordinate, and support a team of approximately 12-16 personnel across software engineering, data science, systems engineering, and technical support functions.
Own program financial management, including CPFF execution, cost tracking, burn rates, staffing plans, forecasts, EAC inputs, invoice support, and coordination with finance and contracts teams.
Manage program deliverables, milestones, schedules, risks, dependencies, and action items with clear ownership and follow-through.
Lead customer-facing communications, including status updates, program reviews, technical discussions, planning meetings, and issue resolution.
Partner with technical leads to ensure software, data science, and analytics efforts are scoped, staffed, prioritized, and delivered in alignment with mission needs.
Support agile planning and execution across sprint, release, roadmap, and backlog management activities.
Translate customer priorities into actionable program plans, technical workstreams, and measurable delivery outcomes.
Provide hands-on technical management and informed decision-making across software development, data pipelines, analytics, system integration, and operational support activities.
Support recruiting, onboarding, performance feedback, team development, and personnel issue resolution.
Maintain strong internal coordination with leadership, capture, contracts, finance, security, and talent acquisition stakeholders.
Identify growth opportunities, shape future work, and help position Falcon for continued mission impact and customer partnership.

Minimum Qualifications

Must be a US citizen.
Current DHS/CBP suitability
Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, information systems, data science, program management, or a related field. Four additional years of relevant experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree. A master's degree may count as an additional 2 years of experience.
6+ years of demonstrated professional experience in program management, technical project management, software delivery management, systems engineering management, data science support, or related technical leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience managing software, data science, analytics, systems engineering, or mission technology programs or teams.
Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams, including direct or matrixed leadership of engineers, data scientists, analysts, or technical support personnel.
Experience managing customer-facing program execution, including status reporting, planning, deliverable coordination, risk management, issue resolution, and stakeholder engagement.
Experience supporting contract, cost, schedule, staffing, and deliverable performance in a government contracting environment.
Working knowledge of agile software development practices and tools, such as Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows.
Technically fluent and comfortable engaging with engineering and data science teams on software delivery, data pipelines, analytics, APIs, cloud-like environments, integration challenges, and operational support considerations.
Must be willing to work in a remote setting or nearby Vantor facility and comfortable communicating via video calls.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience serving as the Program Manager or Deputy Program Manager for a CPFF, T&M, or mixed contract environment.
Experience managing program execution, including cost performance, staffing plans, burn rates, EAC inputs, funding awareness, and coordination with finance and contracts stakeholders.
Experience supporting Department of Homeland Security, specifically CBP and DHS S&T
Hands-on background in software engineering, systems engineering, data engineering, data science, analytics, or technical delivery prior to moving into program or technical management.
Experience managing teams that build, deploy, and sustain software applications, analytical capabilities, data pipelines, or mission support tools in a cloud environment.
Exposure to cloud or cloud-like environments, containerized deployments, CI/CD workflows, streaming data architectures, APIs, databases, and modern software delivery practices.
Experience leading roadmap, backlog, sprint, release, and prioritization activities in partnership with technical leads and customer stakeholders.
Strong ability to translate between customer mission needs, technical implementation details, contractual requirements, and business execution priorities.
Ability to identify program risks early, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and drive timely resolution across internal and external stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to build trust with customers while maintaining accountability for scope, cost, schedule, quality, and team performance.
You are a creative problem-solver who wants to apply breakthrough technologies for the good of humanity and to keep our country safe.
Strong verbal, written, documentation, briefing, facilitation, and organizational skills.

jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

The Associate Project Manager is a generalist member of the PMO supporting a large federal facilities program delivered across multiple sites and task orders. You will work across PMO functions, including schedule, risk, change control, reporting, and deliverable review, and you will be deployed where the program needs support most, including site level work and phase gate reviews. You will operate with oversight from the PMO Director and senior project managers and may lead smaller scopes independently as you build experience.

This is a remote role on Eastern Time with travel to program sites as required. Candidates must be US citizens able to obtain a public trust and security clearance.

What you will do

- Support senior project managers across active task orders with planning, scheduling, procurement coordination, quality, and risk from initiation through closeout.

- Maintain site level risk registers and change control logs, confirm every entry has an owner and a mitigation, and prepare inputs for weekly program risk reviews.

- Track progress against approved baselines, report status and variances, and draft corrective action plans for review.

- Support deliverable reviews and phase gate checkpoints, including coordinating technical reviewers, tracking comments to closure, and confirming deliverables meet contract requirements before submission to the client.

- Prepare and maintain project documentation in accordance with program governance and client requirements, and support the transition of project data into the program's systems, including Power BI and Kahua.

- Identify work requested outside current contract scope and route it through the change control process.

- Step into a needs package or site team on short notice to cover gaps, coordinate with field staff, and report back to the PMO.

- Coordinate with client and partner counterparts to keep submissions, approvals, and reporting aligned.

- Model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent related experience.
Two or more years supporting projects in a federal, infrastructure, facilities, or construction environment. Experience on a federal program with multiple task orders is strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of schedule, risk, and change control fundamentals and the ability to apply them without detailed direction.
Ability to read technical drawings and specifications well enough to support deliverable and site reviews.
Strong written communication, with the ability to turn field and technical information into clear status for leadership.
Comfort working across organizational boundaries with client, partner, and subcontractor staff.
Ability to travel to program sites

Preferred

CAPM or PMP.
Experience with Power BI, Kahua, or similar project information systems.
Prior exposure to FAA, DoD, or other federal facilities programs.
Familiarity with earned value or level of effort contract tracking.

Additional Information

The salary range for this full-time role is $100K - $125K per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package.  Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications. *On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About HUD

HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Technical Program Manager to own complex, time-sensitive data and evaluation programs for frontier AI labs, data vendors, and internal teams. You’ll turn ambiguous technical asks into executable programs, coordinate the people and dependencies required to deliver them, and ensure the resulting data is genuinely useful for evaluating and improving LLMs and agents. You’ll also manage vendors and build the processes, tooling, and operating rhythms that allow HUD to deliver reliably at increasing scale.

Responsibilities

Own data and evaluation programs end-to-end, from initial scoping and requirements gathering through production, quality assurance, delivery, and retrospective
Translate ambiguous requests from AI labs and internal teams into clear specifications such as milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, etc.
Maintain and improve data quality procedures using both quantitative signals and qualitative inspection, including analyzing task coverage, difficulty, reward distributions, etc.
Maintain and improve delivery pipelines at scale, which includes managing external vendors throughout the delivery lifecycle
Streamline the logistics behind data production and evaluation programs by improving workflows, documentation, automation, and cross-functional handoffs
Partner with research, platform, marketplace teams to translate learnings and feedback into product improvements

Experience

You may be a good fit if you have:

Experience owning complex technical programs in AI/ML, data operations, support engineering, applied research, forward-deployed engineering, or a similarly cross-functional environment
Strong quantitative and qualitative judgment about data—you can move between aggregate metrics and individual examples to determine whether a dataset or evaluation is useful, reliable, and representative
Experience maintaining and improving complex processes, especially within project delivery or data contexts
Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, maintain momentum as requirements change, and make sound tradeoffs without waiting for a perfect specification
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn messy technical information into clear decisions, owners, and next steps

Strong Candidates May Also

Experience with RLHF, reinforcement-learning environments, agent evaluations, human-in-the-loop data pipelines, annotation, or expert data collection
Experience supporting frontier AI labs, technical enterprise customers, or research teams with urgent and evolving requirements
Early-stage startup experience with ability to work independently in fast-paced environments

We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.

Team & Company Details

Team Size : ~25 people currently, mostly full-time in-person, but some remote.
Our team: Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.
Company stage: We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand.

Logistics

Employment : Full-time.
Location : We have offices in San Francisco or Singapore but are open to remote candidates who can work hours that 70-80% overlap with either San Francisco or Singapore time zones.
Visa Sponsorship : We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full-time candidates to the US or Singapore.
Timeline : Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2-3 day work trial.

What we offer

Competitive compensation
100% covered top-of-the-line medical, dental, and vision from Blue Shield of CA (US employees)
Lunch and dinner when you’re in the office (in-office employees)
Company-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays
Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees)
Unlimited* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. *By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is.

Due to high volume, we may not actively respond to every application, but feel free to contact us at [[email removed]](mailto:[email removed]) or elsewhere if we missed your application!

You will take full ownership of our flagship company-wide newsletter, end-to-end event execution (Town Halls, All-Hands, cultural milestones), on-brand graphic design activations, channel governance, and LinkedIn employer branding amplification. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role ideal for a proactive producer who thrives in a collaborative, evolving environment.

What You Get To Do Every Day

Conceptualize and produce interactive cultural moments, employee appreciation weeks, and ERG milestones.

Partner with department leads and project owners across the business to source updates, refine raw content for tone and clarity, and package it into engaging, scannable digests.
Graphic Activations & Visual Assets: Design on-brand presentation decks, digital signage, Slack banners, visual toolkits, infographics, and bite-sized multimedia assets (GIFs, short video recaps using Descript/Canva) to make company-wide updates visually compelling and digestible.
Collaborative Content Refining & Storytelling: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to help refine, edit, and optimize announcements and talking points, ensuring communications are clear and aligned with company voice.
Employer Brand, LinkedIn & Glassdoor Amplification: Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and Marketing to translate internal wins, culture spotlights, and employee milestones into engaging LinkedIn posts and employer profile updates (e.g., LinkedIn Life pages, Glassdoor employer branding) that elevate our reputation and strengthen talent attraction.

4–6+ years of experience in employee experience, internal communications, corporate events, or employer branding, with a proven track record of creating compelling programming and tailored content for diverse, multi-segmented workforces—including hourly, corporate, remote, retail, and field/operational populations.

Familiarity with workplace communication tools (e.g., Slack).

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Description

Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value. Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.

Key Responsibilities

Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure

Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
Ability to travel up to 25% of the time to customer sitesֿ

Own the complete project lifecycle from initiation through closure, defining scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and delivery priorities.

Plan and manage sprints, backlog grooming, release cycles, and other Agile delivery activities across Salesforce implementations.

Coordinate Salesforce developers, administrators, architects, QA specialists, and business analysts, allocating tasks, monitoring productivity, removing blockers, and optimizing resource utilization.
Maintain project documentation, including RAID logs, project plans, status reports, and other governance materials.
Track delivery KPIs such as timeline adherence, budget, and quality metrics, ensuring compliance with established delivery frameworks and standards.
Manage change requests and scope creep while proactively escalating critical risks and issues to the appropriate stakeholders.

Requirements

Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid approaches, with the ability to manage projects from initiation to closure.
Hands-on familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem, including platforms such as Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, and the ability to connect business requirements with technical execution.
Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform and its application to sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management.
Proficiency with project management tools such as Zoho Projects, Jira, ClickUp, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with reporting and documentation tools such as Excel and Confluence, including maintaining project documentation and tracking KPIs.
Excellent client communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage expectations, facilitate discussions, and handle escalations effectively.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, particularly in identifying risks early and developing practical mitigation strategies.
High ownership and accountability, structured thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced consulting environments.
Strong collaboration and team leadership skills, with the ability to coordinate diverse technical and business teams.

High ownership and accountability across end-to-end project delivery.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager (TPM)
jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the delivery of LMI's technology portfolio supporting the United States Postal Service (USPS). USPS operates the nation's largest delivery and logistics network and is in the midst of a multi-year modernization effort to improve service reliability, transform the customer experience, and achieve long-term financial sustainability. The TPM will be LMI's senior technical leader on this account: owning the end-to-end deployment of technology solutions into the USPS environment and serving as the trusted advisor who connects hands-on engineering execution to USPS mission and business outcomes.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a professional who can lead the deployment of a diverse portfolio of enterprise technologies into a large, complex federal environment, including ServiceNow, the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure), AI-enabled and agentic solutions, custom software applications, AI-assisted software engineering approaches, and commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) products. The TPM manages a portfolio of concurrent technology projects and deployments, sets and enforces best practices across software development, customer/user experience (CX/UX) design, security, and release management, and is personally accountable for the cost, schedule, quality, and adoption of every solution the team delivers. Equally important to the technical mandate is customer management and relationship building. The TPM builds and sustains strong working relationships with USPS stakeholders, translating their needs into actionable solution roadmaps, communicating clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences, driving consensus, and continuously demonstrating value. The role demands someone who thrives in an environment that emphasizes building, deploying, and iterating in parallel, and who can own the full solution lifecycle alongside the client.

Role Scope & Authority

This senior leadership role reports to the LMI USPS Account Lead and serves as LMI’s primary technical leader on the account. The position oversees a portfolio of multiple concurrent technology initiatives and leads a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, designers, analysts, and subcontractors.

The TPM has broad authority to set delivery standards, prioritize and sequence work, approve technical approaches, escalate risks to USPS and LMI leadership, and recommend staffing and resource decisions. The role interacts regularly with USPS senior IT and business stakeholders at the director and executive levels.

About LMI

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Delivery & Execution:
Serve as LMI's senior technical lead and primary technical point of contact for the USPS account.
On-time, on-budget delivery of technology solutions into the USPS production environment across multiple platforms and technologies.
Build and sustain trusted relationships with USPS stakeholders, acting as the senior advisor on solution approach and continuously identifying opportunities to add value and expand impact.
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of technology deployments into the USPS environment (e.g., intake, solution design, build, integration, test, deployment, and sustainment)
Prioritize, sequence, balance workload, and allocate resources to effectively manage and deconflict a portfolio of concurrent technology projects and deployments

Technical Leadership & Standards:
Translate USPS mission and business needs into technical solution architectures, delivery roadmaps, and Agile backlogs that integrate cleanly with existing USPS systems, data, and enterprise IT.
Lead delivery using Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, and/or Kanban): manage the backlog, sprints, and release planning; run ceremonies; and drive CI/CD and DevSecOps practices for fast, reliable, and secure delivery.
Apply human-centered design and CX/UX best practices throughout delivery so solutions are usable, accessible, and adopted, not just deployed.
Direct the configuration and deployment of platform solutions, as well as bespoke and AI-assisted custom development where a tailored build is the right answer.
Stay current on emerging technology, to include GenAI and agentic AI, low-code/no-code platforms, cloud and platform advances, and modern development tooling, and bring practical innovation to the account.

Quality & Portfolio Management:
Govern technical quality and enforce architecture, coding, integration, and release standards across the team and partner contractors.
Manage cost, schedule, scope, and performance across the portfolio; track financials, forecast spend, prevent cost overruns, and report status against budget and milestones.
Proactively identify and mitigate technical, security, schedule, and delivery risks, implementing corrective actions before they impact the client.
Ensure compliance with USPS and federal cybersecurity, authorization/ATO, data governance, AI risk-management, privacy, and accessibility (Section 508) requirements.
Build, lead, and grow a multidisciplinary team (engineers, architects, designers, data and analytics specialists, and analysts); manage staffing, onboarding, task assignment, performance, and subcontractor coordination.
Develop and maintain technical and program documentation, including solution and system architectures, integration/interface designs, agent and workflow specifications, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
Provide clear, regular status updates, briefings, and after-action reviews to USPS leadership and LMI management; record decisions and action items and keep stakeholders aligned.
Manage contract deliverables, milestones, schedules, and service levels, ensuring high-quality, on-time submissions and adherence to contractual and governance requirements.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience: Minimum of 10 years of experience spanning software engineering, solution architecture, and/or technical program/project management, including enterprise technology delivery and cloud deployments.
Technical & Delivery Expertise:
Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end deployments of enterprise technology into production across two or more of: the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365 / Power Platform / Azure), AI/GenAI solutions, COTS products, and custom software development.
Experience working the architecture of ServiceNow
Deep, working knowledge of modern software development practices, including DevSecOps and CI/CD.
Proven experience leading Agile delivery (Scrum, SAFe, and/or Kanban), including managing Agile teams, backlogs, and release cadences.
Demonstrated experience managing a portfolio of concurrent projects, with direct accountability for cost, schedule, scope, quality, and risk.
Working familiarity with federal IT governance, cybersecurity, authorization/ATO, data governance, and accessibility (Section 508) requirements.
Experience delivering technology in a federal government or comparably large, complex enterprise environment.

Program & Portfolio Management Expertise:
Strong stakeholder-management and customer-relationship skills, including the ability to brief and align senior/executive, non-technical leaders and to drive consensus.
Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation, analysis, and executive briefings.

Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent demonstrated program-management credential, and a recognized Agile/Scrum certification (e.g., PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or SAFe).
Clearance / Eligibility: U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a USPS Public Trust Clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Education: Master's degree or better in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or an MBA with a technology focus.
Experience: Prior USPS or postal experience, or experience supporting other federal civilian agencies, specifically with technology deployments or the management of a portfolio of technology solutions.
Technical & Delivery Expertise:
Hands-on experience with GenAI and agentic AI platforms and AI-assisted/agentic development tooling (e.g., AI coding assistants and agent frameworks), including rapid AI-assisted (“vibe”) development.
Human-centered design, CX, or UX credentials, or a demonstrated portfolio of user-centered solution delivery.
Experience obtaining an Authority to Operate (ATO) / authorization for a SaaS or PaaS solution.
Experience with low-code/no-code platforms.
High-level technical understanding of data engineering, ETL, data analytics, and machine learning.

Program & Portfolio Management Expertise:
Experience leading distributed, multidisciplinary teams and managing subcontractors on federal contracts.

Certifications:
ServiceNow certifications (e.g., Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), Certified Application Developer (CAD)).
Microsoft certifications (e.g., Azure, Power Platform, or Microsoft 365).
Cloud certifications (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud).
Advanced Agile / scaled-Agile certifications (e.g., SAFe Program Consultant (SPC) or Release Train Engineer (RTE)).
IT service management credentials (e.g., ITIL).
Cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or CISM).

The target salary range for this position is $147,000 - $190,000

Summary

We are seeking an experienced Microsoft-focussed Delivery Lead
to lead system integration projects from mobilisation through completion. The role is accountable for client outcomes, delivery performance, commercial control and stakeholder confidence across projects involving multidisciplinary, distributed and third-party teams.

The ideal candidate is a consulting-focused delivery professional with strong general project and program delivery skills. They will combine structured governance with practical leadership, sound commercial judgement and the ability to manage scope, contracts, financials, risk, quality and client expectations. Experience delivering Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM or ERP solutions is desirable but not essential.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Delivery Leadership

Own delivery outcomes across scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, dependencies and benefits.
Mobilise engagements by translating contractual commitments into an integrated delivery plan, governance model, resource plan and delivery controls.
Establish clear roles, decision rights, escalation paths, milestones, acceptance criteria and reporting expectations.
Lead Agile, Hybrid or Waterfall delivery approaches appropriate to the engagement.
Maintain an integrated view of workstreams, critical path, dependencies, client obligations and delivery readiness.
Drive timely decisions, resolve delivery blockers and intervene early when performance varies from plan.
Lead delivery through discovery, design, build, test, deployment, transition and closure, as applicable.
Ensure lessons learned, handover activities and closure obligations are completed.

Project Management

Build trusted client relationships and act as the principal delivery contact for senior stakeholders.
Facilitate discovery workshops, governance forums, steering committees, planning sessions and executive reviews.
Translate business objectives and consulting recommendations into achievable delivery outcomes.
Provide clear, evidence-based advice on priorities, trade-offs, delivery options and impacts.
Challenge assumptions constructively and help clients make informed decisions.
Align business, functional and technical stakeholders around scope, outcomes and delivery priorities.
Communicate complex delivery matters clearly to executive and non-technical audiences.
Identify opportunities to improve client outcomes, extend value or support follow-on work without compromising current delivery commitments.
Manage difficult conversations professionally, including delays, scope pressure, quality concerns and unmet client obligations.

Contract Management

Review and understand the contract, Statement of Work, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, deliverables, acceptance criteria and client obligations.
Translate contractual commitments into delivery controls, work plans and traceable acceptance arrangements.
Maintain alignment between contracted scope, the delivery backlog, solution design, schedule, resourcing and financial forecasts.
Monitor client and supplier obligations and address late, incomplete or changed inputs before they affect delivery.
Identify scope gaps, ambiguity, relief events and contractual risks early and escalate them appropriately.
Lead change control by assessing impacts to scope, schedule, cost, resources, quality and benefits.
Prepare change requests and support commercial negotiations with account, legal and commercial stakeholders.
Prevent uncontrolled scope growth and ensure additional effort is formally assessed and approved before commitment.
Manage deliverable submission, review, acceptance, rejection and remediation in accordance with the contract.
Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence to support contractual and commercial decisions.

Commercial Management

Own project budgets, forecasts, revenue, cost, margin and financial performance.
Monitor sold-versus-delivered performance, burn rate, effort, resource utilisation and estimate-to-complete.
Reconcile the delivery plan, staffing model and financial forecast regularly.
Identify margin erosion, unplanned effort or forecast variance early and implement corrective action.
Validate time, expenses, milestones and invoicing inputs.
Work with account and commercial leaders to manage contractual exposure, change requests and recovery plans.
Balance customer outcomes with responsible commercial decision-making.
Contribute to proposals, estimates, delivery models, Statements of Work and pre-sales reviews.
Support delivery readiness and solution-to-delivery handover before commitments are made to clients.

Governance

Establish fit-for-purpose governance that supports timely decisions rather than administrative reporting.
Maintain and actively manage risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions and actions.
Produce concise status reporting focused on outcomes, variance, decisions, customer impact and required intervention.
Escalate bad news early, with clear facts, impacts, options and recommendations.
Define quality gates, review points and acceptance evidence across the lifecycle.
Ensure deliverables meet contractual requirements, agreed acceptance criteria and professional quality standards.
Coordinate independent assurance or quality reviews where required and drive resulting corrective actions.
Maintain delivery compliance with organisational methods, policies, security requirements and client governance.
Protect delivery evidence, approvals and decision records.

Stakeholder Management

Act as the primary delivery interface for client sponsors, executives and governance forums.
Set and manage realistic expectations regarding scope, timing, cost, quality and client dependencies.
Build alignment across client, account, practice, vendor and delivery stakeholders.
Prepare and lead steering committee discussions, presenting a clear view of status, decisions, risks and recovery actions.
Tailor communications to executive, business, functional and technical audiences.
Maintain stakeholder confidence through transparency, consistency and follow-through.
Manage escalations calmly and coordinate an agreed response across the engagement leadership team.

Team and Resource Leadership

Lead cross-functional teams including architects, consultants, developers, engineers, business analysts, testers, change specialists and project support.
Coordinate onshore, offshore, nearshore, client and third-party contributors.
Establish team ways of working, delivery rhythms, accountability and collaboration expectations.
Manage resource demand, capacity, onboarding, performance and role clarity.

Job Title:

Location:
Burnaby, BC

Canada R&D Center NPI Manager

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead the development and industrialization of utility-scale and C&I battery energy storage products. This role owns project execution from concept through mass production. It coordinates mechanical, electrical, firmware, manufacturing, supply chain, and certification teams to deliver products on time, on budget, and to quality targets. The ideal candidate combines strong project leadership with enough hands-on mechanical and electrical depth to engage credibly in design reviews, supplier discussions, and technical trade-off decisions.

Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional BESS product development projects (cabinets, containers, and core subsystems such as BMS, PCS, and EMS) through a stage-gate NPI process, from concept and prototype through validation, pilot build, and mass production.
Build and maintain integrated project plans covering schedule, budget, resources, deliverables, and gate criteria. Track progress and escalate risks early.
Drive technical decision-making across disciplines. Facilitate design reviews and help resolve mechanical, electrical, and thermal integration issues and trade-offs between cost, performance, schedule, and manufacturability.
Own supplier qualification for key components and contract manufacturers. This includes technical evaluation, capability audits, sample and first-article approval (FAI), PPAP/APQP-style deliverables, and ongoing quality performance tracking.
Establish and improve engineering processes, including design review gates, DFMEA/PFMEA, engineering change management (ECR/ECN/ECO), BOM and configuration control, and documentation standards aligned with the company QMS (ISO 9001).
Coordinate certification and compliance activities (UL 9540, UL 9540A, UL 1973, UL 1741, NFPA 855, and related standards) with test labs, engineering teams, and external consultants.
Plan and oversee validation and reliability testing (environmental, thermal, vibration, electrical safety) and track issue closure through production readiness.
Work with manufacturing and supply chain teams on DFM/DFA, line readiness, cost reduction, and supply chain localization in North America.
Serve as the main technical point of contact for internal stakeholders and, where needed, customers and partners. Provide clear status reporting to management.
Coordinate with global R&D and manufacturing teams across time zones.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of engineering experience in energy storage, EV, power electronics, or industrial equipment.
Direct experience with utility-scale and/or C&I BESS product development is strongly preferred.
Proven track record taking hardware products from prototype to mass production through a structured NPI process.
Hands-on experience with supplier qualification, supplier audits, and managing contract manufacturers.
Solid working knowledge of both mechanical (enclosures, structures, thermal management, air/liquid cooling) and electrical (HV DC architecture, battery modules and racks, PCS, BMS, wiring and protection) aspects of energy storage systems.
Familiarity with engineering process frameworks such as stage-gate, APQP, DFMEA, and engineering change control. Experience working within an ISO 9001 quality system.
Knowledge of UL/NFPA certification processes for energy storage (UL 9540, UL 9540A, UL 1973, NFPA 855) is an asset.
Proficiency with project management and engineering tools (MS Project or equivalent, Jira, PLM/PDM systems).
Excellent communication, organization, and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to drive accountability without direct authority.
PMP or equivalent certification is an asset.
Proficiency in Mandarin is an asset for working with global engineering and supply chain teams.

About PotisEdge

PotisEdge Co., Ltd., founded in 2015, specializes in three core business areas: EV Battery Systems, Smart Energy Storage Systems, and Hydrogen Fuel Battery Systems. With a commitment to "independently developing core BESS technologies across the entire stack," including iCCS, BMS, and EMS, PotisEdge focuses on advancing energy system technologies and delivering innovative smart energy solutions for diverse applications. Join us to lead innovative energy storage projects from concept to market while advancing your career in technical project management.

Job Description:

to join our Program Management Team based in Bingen, WA.

In this role, you'll manage executing assignments for Flexrotor programs and contracts, supporting the development of additional efforts and opportunities to expand our business. You will assist in leading efforts to establish, forecast, implement, and monitor activities associated with the scope, schedule, and budgets of assigned Flexrotor programs/contracts. This role requires strong coordination across involved departments; scheduling and budget management; tracking changes; support for contract/proposal execution; and risk assessment and mitigation for assigned programs.

The Airbus Helicopters Flexrotor Program offers one of the most advanced small tactical unmanned aerial systems (STUAS) with vertical take-off and landing (VTOL). Work for Indiana

Begin a fulfilling career with the State of Indiana by joining one of the largest employers in the state, offering a range of opportunities across 60+ agencies. At the state, you'll find competitive compensation, a robust benefits package and a commitment to work-life balance. Most importantly, you'll have the chance to make a real and measurable impact on the lives of Hoosiers across Indiana.

About Indiana Department Of Environmental Management (IDEM)

Our mission is to implement federal and state regulations to protect human health and the environment while allowing the environmentally sound operations of industrial, agricultural, commercial, and governmental activities vital to a prosperous economy. We issue air, water, and solid and hazardous waste permits that restrict discharges to environmentally safe levels. Staff members inspect and monitor regulated entities; provide compliance and technical assistance; monitor and assess air, land, and water quality; use enforcement actions as necessary to ensure compliance; and respond to incidents involving spills to soil or waters of the state.

Role Overview

As a senior project manager within the Petroleum Remediation Section, you will oversee Leaking Underground Storage Tank (LUST) & petroleum/independent closure program sites, guiding petroleum remediation projects from initial incident through final closure. This role involves communicating with internal tech staff, external consultants, liable parties, contractors, attorneys, developers, redevelopment corporations, and owners and operators of regulated storage tanks as necessary. Ensuring responsible parties comply with state and federal cleanup regulations (IC 13-23, IC 13-24, 329 IAC 9, and 40 CFR 280 Subparts E and F). jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Stimulus Technologies is a leader in technology services, dedicated to bridging the digital divide in underserved communities. With operations across California, Missouri, Nevada, New Mexico, and Oregon, we deliver high-speed, reliable connectivity that transforms lives and businesses. We also offer IT, VoIP, and CyberSecurity services to a range of clients.

Position Overview

Own the project. Navigate the complexity. Deliver on the promise.

As a Project Manager at Stimulus Technologies, you lead grant-funded fiber deployment projects from design kickoff through construction and final network turnover, where execution isn’t just about timelines, but strict compliance, funding milestones, and public accountability. You are the single point of ownership for delivering projects that meet aggressive build schedules while satisfying state and federal grant requirements.

This is a high-ownership role where you’ll manage competing priorities across engineering partners, contractors, internal teams, and clients, while ensuring every decision aligns with budget, schedule, and reimbursement eligibility. You’ll proactively manage risk, enforce accountability, and keep projects moving in an environment where delays and missteps have real financial consequences. If you thrive in complex, high-stakes projects and want to lead work that directly impacts communities, this is your opportunity to take ownership and deliver at scale.

Essential Functions

Project Planning and Schedule Management

Develop and maintain the master project schedule encompassing design, permitting, construction, drop installation, testing, and network turnover milestones.
Coordinate schedule dependencies across the engineering firm (design and permitting), construction contractors (mainline build), and in-house crews (drop installation) to ensure alignment and prevent downstream delays.
Establish project milestones and critical path items; proactively identify schedule risks and develop mitigation plans.
Track and enforce compliance with grant-mandated buildout timelines, reporting deadlines, and program-specific milestone requirements.
Manage project scope and change control processes; evaluate and document the cost, schedule, and scope impact of all change requests before approval.
Facilitate project kickoff meetings and establish roles, responsibilities, and communication cadences with all internal and external stakeholders.

SOW, Contract, and Budget Management

Monitor the engineering firm’s performance against their SOW, deliverable schedules, and contract terms; document deviations and coordinate corrective actions with the Construction Manager and Director of Project Management.
Monitor construction contractor performance against contract terms, pay application accuracy, and change order justifications in coordination with the Construction Manager.
Develop and manage project budgets; track actual costs against forecasts and report variances to the Director of Project Management.
Review and approve invoices from the engineering firm, construction contractors, and permitting agencies for accuracy and contract alignment before processing.
Ensure all project expenditures are properly documented and categorized for grant reimbursement and compliance reporting.
Maintain organized contract files including SOWs, amendments, change orders, and correspondence for each project.

Stakeholder and Client Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for the client on project status, deliverables, and issue resolution.
Prepare and deliver regular project status reports to the client, Director of Project Management, and internal leadership including schedule performance, budget status, risks, and upcoming milestones.
Facilitate regular project status meetings with the client, engineering firm, construction contractors, and internal teams.
Manage client expectations and proactively communicate schedule or scope changes with proposed solutions.
Coordinate with the client on subscriber enrollment, service activation timelines, and drop installation priorities.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate with the Construction Manager on construction progress, contractor issues, and field resource needs.
Coordinate with the Permitting Manager on permit submittal schedules, approval status, and any permitting constraints affecting the construction schedule.
Coordinate with the Drop Installation Crew Manager on drop scheduling, production rates, and compliance with mandated installation timelines.
Work with the engineering firm to track design and permitting deliverable progress and ensure deliverables feed into the construction schedule on time.
Coordinate the construction-to-operations turnover process, ensuring all documentation, testing, and acceptance criteria are met before network handoff.
Identify resource conflicts or bottlenecks across projects and work with the Director of Project Management to prioritize and resolve.

Grant Compliance and Reporting

Ensure all project activities and documentation comply with state and federal grant program requirements.
Prepare and submit required grant reports, progress updates, and milestone certifications on schedule.
Maintain auditable project records including schedules, budgets, invoices, change orders, and deliverable logs for grant compliance purposes.
Track grant reimbursement submissions and coordinate with finance on draw schedules and funding status.
Stay current on grant program requirements and proactively communicate any compliance risks to the Director of Project Management.

Education and Experience

Required

High school diploma or GED; bachelor’s degree in project management, construction management, engineering, business, or related field preferred.
Minimum 5 years of project management experience in telecom, broadband, fiber optic, or utility construction.
Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, and contractor/vendor relationships.
Strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction phases including design, permitting, mainline build, and drop installation.
Experience with SOW and contract compliance management for third-party engineering or construction firms.
Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent) and Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client-facing reporting and stakeholder management.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
Valid driver’s license with the ability to travel to project sites as needed.

Preferred

PMP certification or equivalent project management credential.
Experience with government-funded or grant-funded broadband deployment programs (BEAD, RDOF, ReConnect, CAF, or similar).
Familiarity with FTTH/FTTP deployment at scale.
Background in OSP engineering or construction management.
Experience with grant compliance reporting and reimbursement processes.

Alignment with Core Values

At Stimulus Technologies, our core values define how we work. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

Driven to Grow – Continuously seeks to develop professionally, stays current with industry practices, and pushes to improve processes and outcomes.
See a Need – Fill a Need – Proactively identifies gaps, obstacles, or opportunities and takes action without waiting to be asked.
Elevate Others – Mentors teammates, shares knowledge freely, and actively contributes to a positive and collaborative work environment.
Extreme Ownership – Takes full accountability for results, decisions, and mistakes; does not deflect blame or make excuses.
Celebrate Success – Recognizes contributions of team members, acknowledges milestones, and fosters a culture where wins are shared.

Stimulus Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Management reserves the right to amend and change responsibilities to meet business and organizational needs as necessary.

? Vous avez envie d’être au cœur des enjeux de performance, de rentabilité, de process, d’outils et d’IA
?

Rejoignez HUGE TOGETHER
en tant que Business Operations Manager !

HUGE TOGETHER
est un groupe indépendant qui allie conseil, créativité, performance et innovation
pour accompagner les marques dans leur transformation et leur croissance.

Le groupe réunit aujourd’hui 120 talents au sein de 4 entités complémentaires :

MethodeWeb, notre agence de performance digitale spécialisée en SEO, SEA et acquisition, récemment acquise
Genius, notre cabinet de conseil spécialisé en placement d’experts du marketing digital
Hungry and Foolish, notre agence de publicité intégrée
Foolish, notre agence de création Social Media et Influence

https://www.hugetogether.com/

À noter : Genius, entité qui gère ce recrutement, fait partie du groupe HUGE TOGETHER.

Le poste

Dans le cadre de la structuration du groupe, nous créons un poste de Business Operations Manager
directement rattaché à la Direction Générale du Groupe.

Votre rôle : analyser, outiller et mettre en œuvre la structuration et le pilotage de la performance des entités du groupe.

Vos principales missions seront :

Pilotage de la performance et de la rentabilité :

Construire et faire vivre une analyse de la rentabilité par pôle, équipe et mission : marge, staffing, temps passé...
Mettre en place et suivre les tableaux de bord de pilotage permettant à la Direction de disposer d’une vision claire de la performance
Identifier les écarts, les leviers d’amélioration et contribuer à leur mise en œuvre
Fiabiliser les données nécessaires au pilotage de l’activité

Process et outils :

Cartographier les process clés, identifier ce qui fonctionne et ce qui doit être optimisé

Faire dialoguer les différents outils et sources de données pour fiabiliser et automatiser le pilotage

Améliorer les process RH et le dimensionnement des effectifs (staffing), en fonction de la charge et de la rentabilité, pour absorber les variations d’activité
Participer à la préparation et au suivi des recrutements

IA et automatisation :

Identifier les tâches et processus sur lesquels l’IA peut permettre de gagner du temps et en efficacité
Prototyper et mettre en place des automatisations et de petits outils grâce à l’IA
Accompagner les équipes dans l’adoption de nouveaux usages, notamment sur les sujets de production, d’acquisition et de gestion

Credit management et appui à la Direction :

Structurer le processus de facturation, relance et recouvrement afin d’améliorer le suivi et de réduire le BFR
Faire remonter les informations clés à la Direction du Groupe

Le poste est basé dans les bureaux du groupe à Paris 8, quartier Saint-Lazare
.

Vous bénéficierez de 2 à 3 jours de télétravail.

Votre profil

Diplômé(e) d'une école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou équivalent, vous disposez de 4 à 6 ans d'expérience, idéalement en cabinet (conseil, audit, transformation...)
Vous avez une très bonne capacité d’analyse et savez transformer des données en constats puis en actions concrètes
Vous êtes particulièrement à l’aise avec les chiffres, la data et les analyses de rentabilité et savez construire et faire vivre des tableaux de bord
Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’IA appliquée, notamment dans une logique de vibecoding : vous savez utiliser l’IA pour prototyper des solutions, automatiser certaines tâches et construire de petits outils
Vous êtes très autonome dans l’exécution, organisé(e) et rigoureux(se)
Vous avez un excellent relationnel et êtes capable d’échanger avec des interlocuteurs variés, jusqu’à la Direction
Une compréhension des enjeux du digital et de la performance marketing (SEO, SEA, acquisition) serait un plus
Surtout, vous avez envie de rejoindre une PME et de mettre les mains dans le concret, dans un environnement où les process et les outils sont encore en construction

Un rôle à fort impact : vous serez au cœur de la stratégie et du développement des entités et aurez un impact direct sur leur organisation, leur pilotage et leur rentabilité.
Une forte exposition à la Direction du Groupe : vous travaillerez directement avec le Directeur Général et serez impliqué(e) dans des sujets clés pour le développement du Groupe.
Un poste très transverse : performance, finance, RH, staffing, process, outils, data et IA... vous interviendrez sur des sujets variés avec une vraie autonomie dans leur mise en œuvre.

Un cas pratique pour vous projeter concrètement dans les enjeux du poste
