jobs.description:
Introduction

The Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation - Homeowner Protection Program is seeking a motivated and results-driven Administrator III Supervisor to join our team.

This position plays a key role in supporting agency operations by supervising professional and/or support staff, coordinating workflow, implementing policies and procedures, and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and service delivery. The incumbent may also work closely with executive leadership on special projects, policy development, research, operational planning, and initiatives that support the agency’s overall mission.

The ideal candidate is a confident leader who can effectively manage multiple priorities, communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment, and build collaborative working relationships. We are looking for someone who is organized, adaptable, solutions-oriented, and committed to providing high-quality administrative leadership in a fast-paced public service environment.

If you are ready to bring your leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills to a position where your work can make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply.

GRADE

STD0018

LOCATION OF POSITION

SDAT-Homeowner Protection Program

Tax Sales Ombudsman Department

700 E. Pratt Street, 2nd Floor

Baltimore, Maryland 21202

Main Purpose of Job

The Homeowner Protection Program (HPP) Manager is primarily responsible for running and overseeing the day-to-day operations of the HPP, which removes enrolled homeowners from tax sale by paying off their tax liabilities to Counties or private investors, records a lien on their property, sets them up on a repayment plan, and assists them with paying their debt back to SDAT and planning to pay future taxes that become due.

The Manager ensures efficient and effective management of the Program, which includes application processing, enrollment, payment processing, case management, accounting, and supervising appropriate staff. The Manager continually develops and monitors systems for maintaining quality control, creative troubleshooting, and providing excellent customer service. The Manager continually develops and improves program processes, enrollee assistance strategies, promotional communications, and overall program implementation and evolution when appropriate, both in collaboration with the Ombudsman and independently, to respond to evolving program needs and further program goals.

The HPP Manager is secondarily responsible for assisting the Office of the State Tax Sale Ombudsman. This may include supervising the Tax Sale Specialist, monitoring phone and email inquiries, and by assisting homeowners who are not eligible for the HPP or have not yet become eligible with resolving and avoiding tax delinquency by connecting them with legal services, tax credits, housing and financial counseling, and other helpful resources.

POSITION DUTIES

Manges the Homeowner Protection Program

Oversees and coordinates operations of the Homeowners Protection Program, serving as the Department's subject matter expert on the Program,
Oversees the application process, including an initial review wilhin a reasonable time once an application is received.
Oversees the enrollment process. Reviews all applications fairly and uniformly. To the extent practical, develops objective criteria to evaluate and score applications. Performs final review of applications and recommends enrollees to the TSO.
Oversees handling of enrollees. Manages and tracks accounting aspects of the process. processes loan agreements. manages payments te the counties and private investors. records liens. and tracks monthly payments and status of outstanding debt. Formulates assistance strategies for enrollees, including responsive follow-up when payments are not being made and other communication with enrollees. Takes appropriate action if future tax liabilities become due.
Takes a customer service driven approach, ensuring that the Tax Sale Help line. email, and other points of contact are responded to adequately. Handles customer escalation that otherwise would rise to the level of the TSO.
Sets rules and processes for shared emails, phone queues, and otherwise through use of Freshdesk (email/CRM) and 8x8 (VolP).
ln close coordination with TSO, monitors the HPP Fund ta inform future budget and enrollment projections. Utilizes resources as efficiently and effectively as possible, and requests additional funding and staff when justified.
Ensures all laws, regulations, and policies relevant to the Program are being followed. Seeks out and shares relevant best practices with other SDAT teams and government agencies.
Establishes, maintains. and communicates clear policies and procedures for staff and members of the public.
Coordinates with other SDAT teams to determine equipment, software, and supply needs for HPP.
Continuously considers and recommends improvements to the Program and it processes.
Serves as Program point of contact to government and non-governmental organizations.
Demonstrates discretion when handling persona! information.
Conducts an at least annual review of all aspects of the program, including updating paper and online applications as appropriate.
Documents these procedures and responsibilities. taking a proactive approach ta risk management and identifying and resolving potential audit concerns before they grow.
Delegates these tasks to subordinates as appropriate.

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Graduation from an accredited high school or possession of a high school equivalency certificate.

Experience: Six years of administrative staff or professional work.

Notes

Candidates may substitute 30 college credit hours from an accredited college or university for each year up to four years of the required experience.
Candidates may substitute the possession of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and two years of experience in administrative staff or professional work for the required experience.
Candidates may substitute the possession of a Master's degree from an accredited college or university for the required experience.
Candidates may substitute U.S. Armed Forces military service experience as a commissioned officer involving staff work related to the administration of rules, regulations, policy, procedures and processes, or overseeing or coordinating unit operations or functioning as a staff assistant to a higher ranking commissioned officer on a year-for-year basis for the required experience

Preferred Qualification

DESIRED OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience supervising professional and/or administrative support staff, including assigning work, monitoring performance, coaching employees, and reviewing completed assignments.

Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures, rules, regulations, or administrative directives in a professional work environment.

Experience tracking assignments, deadlines, performance measures, projects, or other operational activities using spreadsheets, databases, or other automated systems.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating complex administrative information to employees, managers, executives, or external stakeholders.

Experience analyzing operational issues, identifying solutions, and making recommendations to management.

LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS AND CERTIFICATIONS

Employees in this classification may be assigned duties which require the operation of a motor vehicle. Employees assigned such duties will be required to possess a motor vehicle operator's license valid in the State of Maryland.

SELECTION PROCESS

Please make sure that you provide sufficient information on your application to show that you meet the qualifications for this recruitment. All information concerning your qualifications must be submitted by the closing date. We will not consider information submitted after this date. Successful candidates will be ranked as Best Qualified, Better Qualified, or Qualified and placed on the eligible (employment) list for at least one year .

EXAMINATION PROCESS

The assessment may consist of a rating of your education, training, and experience related to the requirements of the position. It is important that you provide complete and accurate information on your application. Please report all experience and education that is related to this position

Benefits

STATE OF MARYLAND BENEFITS

Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy 10 to 25 days of annual (vacation) leave per year (depending on seniority), 15 days of sick leave, 6 personal days, and 11 paid state holidays.

Family-Friendly Policies: Eligible employees receive paid family and medica leave to care for a child within six months of birth or adoption.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
About the company

TinkerLabs is a problem-solving and innovation consulancy that applies Design Thinking and Behavioral Science to address complex business and social impact challenges. Since 2013, the team has partnered with 100+ organizations across 15+ industries, including Fortune 500 companies, leading Indian enterprises, and global non-profits. Clients range from Microsoft, Unilever, Tata Group, Mahindra & Mahindra, Flipkart, and L&T to the Gates Foundation, UNFPA, and GIZ. Through consulting engagements, sprints, and workshops, TinkerLabs helps teams generate bold, human-centered, and simple ideas that drive meaningful change. More information about their work and collaborations is available at www.tinkerlabs.in.

About the role

Can you turn ambitious project visions into seamless operational reality? We are hiring for a Program Manager
who can balance high-energy facilitation with rigorous operational mastery for a very important and elaborate education programme at TinkerLabs. 

We’ve partnered with a large corporate to equip students from design and engineering institutes in India to build products and services for a social impact cause using our methodology. The goal is to help students build strong ideas and connect them to an incubator that brings their ideas to life. 

We’re looking for a Program Manager who can run this national-scale design thinking workshop program - you’ll be the force that turns a complex programme run smoothly for all stakeholders involved. And when a session needs a facilitator, you are able to stand up and run it yourself.

This is not a coordination role. You are expected to shape the plan for the year, defend it with the client, and then deliver it.

What will you do

Master multi-city operations:
Build and manage the end-to-end programme roadmap across multiple colleges nationwide. Track milestones, coordinate schedules, mitigate risks and bottlenecks, manage stakeholder and client communications and ensure seamless delivery
Organise the chaos:
Drive key activities and keep track of all moving parts - institutional partnerships, workshop content, facilitators training, workshop sessions, student submissions, feedback loops and important project tasks without missing a beat
Manage client trust:
Lead client-facing communications with poise and empathy. Set clear expectations, navigate bottlenecks seamlessly and bring grounding and ease to complex timelines
Streamline team resourcing:
Balance workloads, forecast talent needs and hire the right people
Manage hybrid delivery:
Seamlessly bridge the gap between digital learning platforms and in-person events across various facilitators- keeping student engagement consistent and the quality of project high
Facilitate with high energy:
Lead engaging, interactive design thinking workshops both in-person and online 

What are we looking for:

Must haves:
Proven facilitation & coaching experience:
3+ years of experience leading workshops, teaching, or facilitating design thinking, human-centered design (HCD), or experiential learning modules.
Genuine facilitation ability:
Has ability to command a room independently for 30+ participants - adapt on the fly when an exercise isn't landing, and build quick rapport with college students and faculty alike
Strong project management chops:
Track record of managing complex projects/programmes with multiple moving parts, stakeholders, and strict deadlines - nothing goes missing when working with you
Solid client management and communication skills
: Comfortable delivering bad news, collaborating on solutions, sending clear emails and being seen as a trustworthy face for the client.
Willingness to travel:
Eagerness to travel to college campuses across India (Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3) for live workshop modules

Good to haves:
Experience working with colleges, universities or student communities
in India.
Comfort using AI tools
as part of workshop delivery and content preparation.
A design or education
background.

Besides the work, what is in it for you:

Ownership from day one.
You won't just follow a playbook - you will shape how this massive programme journey unfolds and scales.
High-impact learning.
You will watch students transform from passive learners into confident, empathetic problem-solvers over the course of a full academic year.
High Impact, High Velocity:
We move fast and aim high, offering an environment where you do meaningful, rewarding work while respecting personal boundaries.

How to apply:

To help us get a feel for how you think, we’d love for you to respond to one question:
Tell us about a time when you managed a complex, long-term project with many moving parts. What were the main challenges and how did you pivot from there?

Please feel free to share the response in any format you would do justice to - write it, draw it, record it.

Please share your response, updated resume and relevant work sample/facilitation videos
to curios@tinkerlabs.in
with the subject line: Program Manager_(Your name)

As a human will review all the applications, everyone will receive a reply in due time

Translate business questions into clear metrics, KPIs, data models, and analytical solutions.
Write and optimize complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and data transformations.
Analyze execution plans and improve indexing, query performance, reliability, and scalability.
Design, build, schedule, monitor, and support ETL pipelines, scripts, and automated data-processing jobs in Azure.
Create data-validation, reconciliation, exception-reporting, and quality-control processes.

Partner with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements and present findings clearly.
Proactively communicate progress, assumptions, risks, blockers, dependencies, and data limitations.
Own reporting accuracy, completeness, consistency, documentation, and timely delivery.
Use approved AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while validating all generated output.
Provide production support for data pipelines and reporting solutions as business needs require.

Follow all eHealth Technologies information privacy and security policies, procedures, and standards.
Access, use, and disclose only the minimum necessary covered information required for assigned responsibilities or otherwise permitted by law.
Safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of covered information at all times.

Knowledge And Skill Requirements

Preferred Field of Study:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering, MIS, Information Technology, or a related field from an accredited institution; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

Years Of Experience

7-10 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, data engineering, or a related discipline.

Required Technical Skills

Expert-level SQL Server and T-SQL skills, including complex analytical queries, stored procedures, indexing, execution-plan analysis, and performance optimization.
Advanced Power BI experience, including data modeling, DAX, dashboard development, refresh strategies, and performance tuning.
Strong experience with Salesforce reporting, data extraction, integration, and analysis.
Hands-on experience designing and supporting ETL pipelines, scheduled jobs, and data automation.
Experience with Azure-based data services and cloud-hosted reporting or analytical solutions.
Demonstrated experience producing accurate insights and executive-level reporting for leadership decisions.

Preferred Technical Skills

Python or C# for data processing, automation, scripting, or ETL development.
Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, source control, CI/CD, data governance, and reporting quality controls.
Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, SaaS, or another regulated environment.

Core Competencies

Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent oral and written communication skills across technical, business, and leadership audiences.
Proactively seeks clarification, validates assumptions, and resolves ambiguity before delivery.
Self-driven, accountable, organized, and able to manage competing priorities with minimal supervision.
Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing speed, quality, and reliability.
Strong business acumen, stakeholder focus, collaboration, and continuous-learning mindset.

Directly supervised by the Director of Engineering.
Interacts regularly with eHealth Technologies leadership, technology, operations, product, business teams, customers, and vendors as required.

Main Purpose of Job

Pursuant to Chapter 158 of the Acts of 2026 (House Bill 980 / Kanaiyah's Law), this high-level professional administrative and legal advocacy position serves as the State Foster Youth Ombudsman for youth experiencing out-of-home care statewide. Housed within the SSA Office of Family Advocacy, the incumbent operates with statutory independence to serve as a neutral, objective advocate for youth, caregivers, guardians, resource parents, and adoptive parents interacting with the Department of Human Services (DHS) and Local Departments of Social Services (LDSS). The primary purpose of this role is to enforce accountability and transparency within the state's child welfare infrastructure. The incumbent independently investigates complex complaints regarding the rights and safety of youth in out-of-home care, resolves systemic and individual service delivery gaps, interprets statutory obligations, and delivers executive-level recommendations directly to SSA and DHS leadership to drive statewide operational and policy improvements. At all times, the incumbent will provide customer service to both internal and external customers that meets or exceeds the standards set by the Department.

POSITION DUTIES

Executes all duties, investigations, and reporting mandates in strict accordance with the statutory requirements of House Bill 980 (Kanaiyah's Law).
Investigates complex, high-profile complaints and alleged violations concerning the rights, placement conditions, and safety of youth experiencing out-of-home care across all 24 Maryland jurisdictions.
Conducts Independent Fact-Finding Reviews to evaluate whether actions taken by LDSS or contractual providers conform to federal and state laws, COMAR regulations, SSA policies, and established child welfare practice standards.
Provides authoritative legal and technical expertise regarding child welfare, juvenile court jurisdiction, out-of-home placement restrictions (including the statutory ban on unlicensed settings), custody/guardianship matters, and due process appeal rights.
Interprets and applies complex legal frameworks, consent decrees, and agency directives to determine appropriate resolutions for aggrieved youth and stakeholders.
Formulates formal corrective recommendations based on investigative findings and consults directly with SSA Executive Leadership, Local Department Directors, and the Office of the Attorney General (OAG) to resolve sensitive or high-risk systemic non-compliance issues.
Ensures absolute statutory compliance with strict confidentiality boundaries, HIPAA, mandated reporting protocols, and disclosure exemptions during all investigative and advocacy operations.
Establishes and leads statewide outreach strategies designed to inform youth in foster care, kinship caregivers, attorneys, and advocacy groups of the Ombudsman’s role, responsibilities, and mechanism for submitting direct complaints.
Engages directly with youth experiencing out-of-home care to ensure their voices, lived experiences, and rights actively inform SSA programmatic improvements and statutory recommendations.
Represents the Office of Family Advocacy on high-level interagency workgroups, legislative committees, and task forces regarding child welfare reform and accountability.
Collaborates with System Partners, including juvenile courts, panel attorneys, the Office of the Child Welfare Ombudsman, and local social work staff to mediate deep-seated disputes and drive positive case-level outcomes.
Directs the Management and Tracking of the statewide Ombudsman case portfolio, ensuring precise, legally secure documentation of all inquiries, case activities, and final resolutions.
Performs advanced data and trend Analysis to identify recurring systemic deficiencies, regional operational patterns, or gaps in service delivery that negatively impact youth stability.
Authors and edits legally mandated annual, quarterly, and ad hoc public reports detailing Ombudsman activities, case statistics, compliance metrics, and actionable policy or statutory recommendations for the Secretary, the Governor, and the General Assembly.

Minimum Qualifications

Education: A Juris Doctor degree or equivalent degree from an accredited school of law.

Experience: Five years of experience as a practicing attorney.

Notes

Candidates for this classification must be members of the Maryland Bar at the time of appointment.
The above requirements are set by Maryland House Bill 980 Guardianship Assistance Program and State Foster Youth Ombudsman – Establishment (Kanaiyah’s Law).
Candidates may substitute U.S. Armed Forces military service experience as a commissioned officer in General Attorney classifications or General Attorney specialty codes in the Legal and Kindred field of work on a year-for-year basis for the required education and experience.

Desired Or Preferred Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess the following:

One year of experience in representing a government agency, public service law, or serving as an advocate in a community activist/services capacity.
One year of experience in juvenile law, Child Welfare or Human Services.
One year experience as a judicial clerk.
Completion of at least two relevant courses in human services or public policy, OR successful completion of a clinical program or internship in a legal setting serving human services clients.

Please review the following job description:

The Business Data Analyst II supports the Corporate Real Estate and Workplace (CREW) team by transforming business, operational, and financial data into reliable datasets, actionable insights, and decision-ready reporting. The role partners with CREW stakeholders to understand business questions, define analytical requirements, and develop scalable data products using SQL and/or Python with data sourced from Snowflake. The analyst designs and maintains Power BI dashboards and visualizations that communicate trends, performance, risks, and opportunities to business leaders. In addition, the role helps automate financial operations activities by identifying process improvement opportunities, translating manual work into repeatable solutions, and evaluating emerging technologies. This includes exploring Agentic AI use cases and building proofs of concept in Microsoft Copilot to demonstrate business value, control considerations, and opportunities for broader adoption. The analyst applies a strong understanding of end-to-end data flows, data quality, and business context to ensure analyses are accurate, traceable, and aligned with CREW needs.

****Position has in office expectations and is not a remote role.****

For this opportunity: Truist will not sponsor an applicant for work visa status or employment authorization, nor will we offer any immigration-related support for this position (including, but not limited to H-1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN-1 or TN-2, E-3, O-1, or future sponsorship for U.S. lawful permanent residence status.)

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

Partner with CREW business and technology stakeholders to translate operational and financial questions into clear data, reporting, visualization, and automation requirements.
Build, test, document, and maintain reusable datasets and analytical models using SQL and/or Python with data sourced from Snowflake and other approved enterprise systems.
Develop and support Power BI datasets, dashboards, and visualizations that enable leaders and business partners to monitor performance, identify trends, and make informed decisions.
Validate data completeness, accuracy, and consistency; investigate anomalies; document business rules and lineage; and coordinate remediation with data owners, source-system teams, and platform administrators.
Apply knowledge of CREW processes and financial operations to provide meaningful interpretation of analytical results, not solely report production.
Identify and support automation opportunities across financial operations activities, with emphasis on controls, traceability, process efficiency, and sustainable support models.
Explore Agentic AI and Microsoft Copilot use cases, develop proofs of concept, assess feasibility and business value, and document requirements, limitations, risks, and recommended next steps.
Use Microsoft Power Apps and related Power Platform capabilities, when appropriate, to develop or enhance lightweight business solutions that improve data capture, workflow execution, and user experience.
Lead small analytical or automation initiatives and play a significant role in larger, cross-functional efforts, managing dependencies, risks, testing, stakeholder communication, and implementation activities.
Explain complex data, technical concepts, and analytical findings to a range of audiences through concise narratives, visualizations, and recommendations.
Work independently with minimal guidance, exercise judgment across multiple sources of information, and serve as a resource to teammates and business partners.

Required Qualifications:

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor's degree and 2-5 years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
In-depth knowledge of principles, practices, theories, and/or methodologies associated with the professional discipline (e.g., information technology, project management, finance, risk management, etc.). 3. Experience using SQL to query, join, transform, and validate data from enterprise data platforms or cloud data warehouses.
Focus on process automation to improve efficiency
Understands foundational concepts of other related professional disciplines.
Experience developing business intelligence reporting and data visualizations in Power BI or a comparable enterprise analytics platform.
Knowledge of the industry's competitive landscape and the factors that differentiate Truist and its competitors in the market.
Ability to interpret and explain complex information to a range of audiences and build consensus among different stakeholders.
Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple assignments, and provide direction or knowledge-sharing to less experienced teammates.

Preferred Qualifications:

Knowledge of data quality, reconciliation, documentation, controls, and end-to-end data processes.
Experience supporting process improvement, reporting automation, or workflow automation initiatives.
Experience managing small to mid-size projects or workstreams with moderate complexity.
Experience using SQL and/or Python for data preparation, analysis, automation, or prototyping.
Strong experience with Microsoft Power Apps and related Power Platform capabilities.
Financial acumen or experience performing financial analysis, operational analytics, forecasting, reconciliation, or management reporting.
Experience with Snowflake and development of governed, reusable datasets for reporting and analytics.
Experience exploring Agentic AI use cases or building proofs of concept in Microsoft Copilot or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
Experience supporting corporate real estate, workplace, facilities, capital projects, or related operational functions.

The Data Analyst, Revenue Analytics will support business-case and technical requirements of the Revenue Analytics department by capturing business requirements, developing ad-hoc queries/procedures, and constructing data models to build reports and dashboards. This position will compile data relating to revenue cycle, accounting and finance operations, weekly operational dashboards, cash flow, strategic pricing, and profitability. This position will be capable of translating end-user requirements into a structured, logical data sourcing plan and developing business-friendly reports, analyses, and impact models. This position will work directly with source database queries, schemas, and routine stored procedures across multiple platforms, including patient accounting systems, clinical systems, and data warehouses while utilizing SSMS, T-SQL, MS Excel, Power BI, and MS PowerPoint. Extract, aggregate, and organize data from SQL databases that house revenue cycle data from separate front-end billing applications.
Routinely evaluate data for accuracy and ensure reporting integrity. Troubleshoot irregular data issues (e.g., Correct non-conforming data relationships or unmapped new data elements).
Gather business and technical requirements from revenue cycle leadership and translate requests into functional operational reports and dashboards using Power BI and Excel.
Provide analytical support through advanced data compilation and predictive modeling for revenue operations, finance, and accounting.
Process EOM reporting package for operational leadership teams.
Generate routine and ad-hoc queries/analysis as requested.
Create SOPs and process flow diagrams as required.
Monitor daily ETL results to ensure source data is loaded in an accurate and timely manner. Troubleshoot and resolve issues, as necessary.
Maintain, repair, and optimize SSIS/SSRS packages, SQL stored procedures and all other related processes as assigned.
Assist with development and maintenance of data dictionaries, business glossaries, and documentation of data flows/lineage.
Utilize Excel Master Data Services (MDS) and other similar tools to correct mapping errors, remedy duplicates, input missing information, and otherwise ensure consistency and completeness of data related to Payors, Bases/Base Codes, Denial Codes, and the like.
Travel on occasion to revenue cycle operations center in West Plains, MO to interact with management team.

Qualifications/Additional Skills

Ability to design and implement discussion-ready, Excel-based dashboards.
Intermediate level of knowledge and experience with sourcing datasets from SQL and a general understanding of data structures and relational schemas.
Basic understanding of Star Schema data model design as it relates to data warehouse and relational database interactions.
Microsoft SQL (SSMS) - Adept knowledge in writing basic to complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and views to retrieve data from relational databases or a data warehouse.
Microsoft SQL (SSRS) – Familiarity with MS Visual Studio and knowledge of SSRS package creation, file generation and transmission, and addition of error handlers to assist with troubleshooting.
Databricks – Entry level knowledge of the Databricks Platform/Lakehouse and its integration with Microsoft SQL to facilitate data transfer and data warehousing, and data management.
AI Tools – Entry level knowledge of appropriate, ethical, and responsible usage of AI Tools such as MS Copilot and the like to solve everyday business problems.
Experience in data aggregation, normalization, and data modeling from multiple sources.
Strong quantitative/analytical skills; strong innovation, problem solving, and conceptual thinking abilities.
Ability to solve ambiguous problems and suggest practical ways to solve them.
A working knowledge of the healthcare industry, insurance billing and third-party reimbursement is strongly preferred.

Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Healthcare Management, or related field from an accredited college or university.
3-5 years of experience working in a business intelligence (BI) related position. Healthcare revenue cycle experience preferred but not required.
Strong experience developing business-friendly decision models that source multiple data sources, formula-based measure creation, and ties aggregations to detailed data.

Proficient with MS Excel, specifically including creation and dynamic use of Pivot Tables and formulaic metrics to analyze data and produce reports.
Entry level knowledge of MS Power BI application and its basic functions.

jobs.description:
Research Analyst – Modeling and Meta-Analysis

Reports to Senior Research Consultant Modeling and Meta-Analysis

Job Summary

As a Research Analyst at OPEN Health, you are an essential contributor to our Modeling and Meta-Analysis team, working across various HEOR projects, which may include health economic modelling, indirect treatment comparisons, and trial data analysis. You are proactive, responsive, and able to balance shifting priorities to ensure promises are kept and expectations are exceeded. You will have responsibility for delivering high-quality outputs and ownership of specific project components, deliverables, and timelines. You will support project leads in a fast-paced, multi-disciplinary, international organization. We would love to hear from you if you are a versatile modeler, statistician, or health economist and would like to take the next step in your career.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Designing and constructing health economic models (i.e., cost-effectiveness models, budget impact models) from scratch, as well as adapting existing models
Developing project reports, analysis plans, and other deliverables
Conducting relevant data analyses (i.e., survival analyses, meta-analysis) to support model development
Helping to ensure timely delivery of project subcomponents by proactively flagging changes to scope and timelines to senior colleagues
Supporting with client interactions and outreach to ensure client satisfaction
Assisting with requests for proposals and developing strong client relationships to win new business
Keeping abreast with the latest developments in the field

Experience, Skills, And Qualifications

Master’s Degree or PhD in any relevant science, such as health economics, econometrics, economics, pharmacy, epidemiology, statistics or medical sciences
Experience within the field of HEOR would be an advantage, specifically hands-on experience in the development of cost-effectiveness and budget impact models, and familiarity with the context of health economic modelling, reimbursement dossiers, and health technology assessment submissions
Intellectual curiosity and independence, to include the ability to self-start and self-teach
Experience with (statistical) software: VBA, R (version control, RMarkdown and Shiny), STAN (or equivalent MCMC simulation software) would be an advantage
Full proficiency in MS Office programs: Excel, Word, PowerPoint
Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) along with the ability to clearly communicate complex methods to other team members and our clients
Proactive, responsive and able to balance shifting priorities
Team player, but also able to work independently
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

About OPEN Health

At OPEN Health, we connect visionary minds, pioneering science, and advanced technology to drive real impact. By uniting people, science, and technology, we activate new opportunities for biopharma innovation. Our expertise across medical affairs and market access unlocks faster, smarter routes to market. We are committed to improving patient outcomes worldwide. To learn more, visit www.openhealthgroup.com.

OPEN Health. The right combination to unlock possibilities.

What We Offer

As a global organization, OPEN Health is committed to supporting our employees and their families through a comprehensive benefits program

Competitive pay, generous paid vacation, holidays and more, across all our locations
Ongoing training and development opportunities which foster and shape your individual career path
An active and growing commitment to bettering the communities our employees call home through our Corporate Social Responsibility program
The opportunity to thrive in a global, collaborative environment while working every day to improve health outcomes and patient wellbeing
Diverse, inclusive culture that encourages you to bring your whole self to work

If we sound like the sort of business environment in which you would thrive, then we would love to hear from you.

OPEN Health does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, colour, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

jobs.description:
Company

INEOS Olefins & Polymers USA

Interested in joining a winning team? A team whose employees are empowered to make a difference?

Grade 32-33

Organizational Context And Job Purpose

The O&P USA business includes the product lines Ethylene, Propylene, Butadiene, Polypropylene (PP) and Polyethylene (PE). Manufacturing sites include Chocolate Bayou Works (Alvin, TX), Battleground Manufacturing Complex (LaPorte, TX), and Carson (Carson, CA), with a division office in League City, TX. Overall O&P USA has approximately 1300 employees, 1,400 contractors, and annual revenue of $3 to $4 billion.

How The Role Fits In

The PE marketplace and our PE product portfolio are exceptionally diverse and require skilful understanding of the market. The PE Business Analyst coordinates with a broad range of personnel including the PE Business Manager, the PE Product Manager, Polymers Controller, Polymers Financial Analyst, Polymers Pricing Analyst, PE Sales Director, PE Channel Sales Director, Sales team members, Product Development Personnel in conjunction with the Segment Teams, Customer Service, and Production Scheduling. The PE Business Analyst also interfaces with Manufacturing Site personnel for Green Belt projects and for PANDA (margin analysis tool) data validation as appropriate.

The Main Purpose Of The Role

The PE Business Analyst provides key business analyses to drive the daily operational tactics and decisions and to support the long term strategy development for the PE product line business.

Responsibilities AND Accountabilities

Develop accurate price realization and rebate forecasts for the monthly GFO, weekly product line updates, and annual budget plan. Analyze accuracy of forecasts and continuously improve.
Provide timely and accurate data analysis to support the PE business strategy including the PE utilization/margin curve, PE industry data and trends, PE market segment analyses, PE margin analyses for asset profitability studies, and other strategic analyses as required.
Provide timely analysis of market and business data to support regularly scheduled decision making meetings including: Supply & Operations Planning, PE Asset Team, PE Business Team, strategic reviews, asset profitability reviews, and major project status reviews.
Provide critical support for the ATN (Authority to Negotiate) process on a daily basis through interface with the sales team to facilitate opportunity definition by sales, through interface with supply chain team on logistics cost to serve for ATN development, and through forward looking margin analysis for opening offer and walk-away points.
As INEOS PE representative to ACC (American Chemistry Council), report INEOS PE data to ACC monthly.
Using aggregate industry data from ACC and Industry Consultants, prepare the monthly PE Industry Report for the sales team to use in discussions with customers. Prepare other analyses for use by the sales team as required.
Serve as SPA for verifying/improving Panda data accuracy and performing quarterly bottom-up margin post audits. Also perform quarterly analysis of customer adherence to contract volume commitments.
Responsible to monitor daily Zemeter reports to ensure adherence to the ATN and spot sales work processes.
Represent the PE Business on the Segment Teams which manages product technical service and development
Serve as backup to perform specified responsibilities in the absence of the PE Product Manager.
Supports HDPE Channel sales as required
Participate in or lead Six Sigma Green Belt project(s) as appropriate.
Internal and external sales accountabilities as needed

Education/Experience

Skills & Knowledge Required

Level Of Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in science or business
Six Sigma Green Belt or Yellow Belt training is a plus.

Skills And Competencies

Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills.
Demonstrated strong computer skills including competency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Powerpoint, and Word). Knowledge of Zemeter, SAP, and/or PANDA is a plus.
Excellent attention to detail and drive to achieve accuracy.
Team player with good interpersonal and communication skills.
Ability to help colleagues adhere to business processes and procedures while progressing successful delivery of business results.
Inquisitive and commercially astute.
Good leadership and project management skills.
Action oriented/proactive with demonstrated strong work ethic.
Basic understanding of many of the following: commercial operations, sales, supply chain/logistics, procurement, technology, finance, accounting, manufacturing, and business systems.

Physical Requirements - Marina View Office

Frequently (70-100%) sitting and keyboard use;

Occasionally (less than 30%) lifting and carrying up to 20 pounds;

Infrequently (10% or less) ascending and descending stairs, bending, stooping, twisting, kneeling, and reaching at/below shoulder height.

The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing data and figures; viewing a computer screen and extensive reading.

Our culture is one of honesty and integrity with an emphasis on safety, health and environmental performance. On our team, people are acknowledged for embracing new practices that help create real value for customers.

IT Project Management.

Stable professional career

Join Our Team

Devis is seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to join a small Agile team supporting a U.S. Department of State program in Washington, DC. The team operates, maintains, and enhances an enterprise financial planning, project management, and monitoring application built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform and used by roughly 400 people. You would be the person who turns what those users need into requirements the developers can build, confirms it works before it ships, and keeps the team's sprints running.

About This Role

This is a contingent-upon-award Senior Business Intelligence Analyst role with Scrum Master duties. You will gather and document requirements from government stakeholders, write user stories, plan and run testing, lead user acceptance testing, and maintain the SOPs, user guides, and training materials that go with each release. You will also serve as the primary Scrum Master for the development team, running Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives and coordinating with the IT Project Manager on priorities and schedule. The application runs in the Department's Microsoft 365 cloud environment and links to a Power BI reporting module backed by a SQL database, so familiarity with that stack helps, but the core of the job is requirements, testing, and Agile facilitation.

What You'll Do

Run the Team's Agile Process

Serve as the primary Scrum Master for the development team
Lead Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives throughout the development lifecycle
Coordinate with the IT Project Manager on sprint priorities, schedule, and release timing
Maintain a prioritized backlog with the government product owner so the team always knows what comes next

Own the Requirements

Work with government stakeholders to gather and document business requirements, process flows, and system enhancement requests
Translate business needs into clear, testable requirements and user stories
Coordinate with developers and stakeholders so requirements are implemented as written and open questions are resolved quickly
Maintain the change request log (enhancement requests, bug fixes, and other system changes, with request date, description, and status) and present it at weekly status meetings with the government

Test and Validate

Build test plans and write and execute test cases and test scripts for each enhancement release
Log defects in the team's tracking tool and follow them through to resolution
Lead user acceptance testing with government stakeholders and confirm each solution meets the business need before release
Support the QA team in test planning and validation activities

Document and Train

Prepare and maintain functional documentation, reports, and training materials, including SOPs, training decks, and user guides
Deliver virtual user training sessions, typically quarterly, using screen-sharing demonstrations of the application
Contribute to the Monthly Status Report and weekly stakeholder briefings

Support Data Quality

Help develop and carry out processes that improve and maintain data quality across the platform so reporting is consistent and accurate
Write requirements and test cases for data integrations between the application and other Department systems

Required Qualifications

What We're Looking For

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree or higher in statistics, computer science, mathematics, or a related field
At least 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a related role
Hands-on experience with software or system testing (functional, regression, or UAT)
Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams

Security Clearance

Active Secret security clearance issued by DCSA, in place before work begins

Required Certifications

None required for this position; see Preferred Qualifications

Technical Skills

Experience writing and executing test cases and test scripts, and documenting defects and issues in a tracking tool
Ability to gather, analyze, and document requirements
Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio
Experience supporting QA teams in test planning and validation activities

Communication & Collaboration

Strong written and verbal communication skills; you will brief government stakeholders every week
Comfort working directly with government product owners, developers, and end users to resolve questions and reach agreement

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform model-driven applications
Experience with Power BI or a similar reporting tool
Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, or equivalent)
Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or a similar backlog and defect tracking tool
Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and reporting queries
Prior work with the Department of State or another federal agency

Performance Expectations

Success in this role means:

Scrum ceremonies run on schedule and the development team starts every sprint with a clear, prioritized backlog
Requirements and user stories are complete and testable before development starts, and enhancements are implemented as written
Enhancements clear testing and user acceptance before release, and defects are logged and tracked to closure
The change request log is current at every weekly status meeting, and SOPs, user guides, and training materials keep pace with releases
Written deliverables meet the government's formats and are accepted within its review cycle

Special Requirements

Must hold an active Secret security clearance issued by DCSA before performance begins; U.S. citizenship is required to hold a clearance
Must sign a nondisclosure agreement and comply with Department of State regulations for the protection of sensitive information
Must be available during the Department's core hours of 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Eastern, Monday through Friday
Must be available for occasional after-hours on-call support, approved in advance, typically when enhancements are pushed to production
Remote work within the continental United States is available under a Department telework agreement (Form DS-4230); there is no minimum on-site requirement, and some in-person work at the Washington, DC site may be requested

Company Overview:

Seerist stands at the forefront of threat and risk intelligence, seamlessly fusing state-of-the-art AI technology with expert human analysis in a cloud-based platform. Our mission is rooted in providing preemptive, critical insights that empower the world's preeminent organizations and vital government bodies.

We are committed to protecting their people, assets, and operations through proactive threat forecasting, real-time event monitoring, and the strategic contextualization of intelligence. This approach not only informs but also catalyzes decisive action, positioning Seerist as a pivotal ally in navigating today’s complex security landscape.

About The Role

Do you enjoy tracing information back to its source, identifying connections, and making sense of incomplete or conflicting evidence?

Seerist is looking for an Open-Source Investigations Analyst
to join our Research & Collections team
. You will investigate and assess the sources that underpin Seerist’s platform, helping our users understand security, operational, and political risks.

Your work will go beyond finding information. You will examine where it comes from, how reliable it is, and how misinformation can affect the picture it presents. You will combine in-depth source research with an understanding of security and geopolitical developments to improve our source coverage and help shape the Seerist platform.

The role combines independent investigation with close collaboration. Working with colleagues across research, product, data science, and commercial teams, you will help translate users’ information needs into research priorities and improvements to the platform.

This is a hybrid role, with three days per week in our office in Reston, Virginia.

Role And Responsibilities

Discover and assess sources. Identify, investigate, and obtain access to online media sources relevant to Seerist’s users. Evaluate their provenance, reliability, and limitations.
Investigate misinformation. Analyze misinformation sources and networks, assessing how they operate, and their influence on the information and security environments.
Track changes in the information landscape. Maintain an understanding of how mainstream and alternative social media platforms areused, andidentifyimplications for our research and collection work.
Support product development and testing. Work with the wider product and data science teams to inform product development, test new features, and provide feedback on functionality and usability.
Understand users’ requirements. Engage directly with platform users to translate their information needs into research and collection priorities.
Support commercial teams. Work with Customer Success and New Business colleagues to explain our source coverage, capabilities, and limitations to customers and prospects.

What We Are Looking For

Strong knowledge of open-source research and investigative methods, including source discovery, verification, and reliability assessment.
Proficiency in a language other than English, with Sinitic language skills particularly valued.
An analytical and inquisitive mindset, with the ability to identify relevant information, connect seemingly unrelated details, and make sound judgments under uncertainty.
A solid understanding of security and geopolitical issues, including their implications for businesses and operations.
Technical aptitude and confidence working with large or complex datasets, with the ability to organize information, identify patterns, and learn new digital tools.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with customer-facing experience, and the ability to adapt your style to different audiences.
A methodical and self-directed approach, with the ability to manage projects independently, maintain quality, and adapt to changing priorities.
Strong collaboration skills, working effectively with colleagues across disciplines and professional backgrounds.

What Seerist Offers  

An opportunity to be a part of a fast-moving organization with cutting edge technology
A culture that is dynamic, diverse, trust-centered, and open to bold ideas
Competitive salary, bonus plan, 401(k) matching, and long-term incentives
Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, and life plans
A flexible and fun work environment that values work-life balance
Unlimited PTO
Up to16 weeks paid parental leave
Tuition Reimbursement
Professional Development Stipend

Primary Purpose

CNA is hiring for Research Analysts
to join their Regional, Strategy and Policy Analysis (RSP) Division. RSP provides senior national security decision-makers with regional and global analysis that links strategy, policy, and operations. RSP is hiring for Research Analysts to join their research programs below:

Ally and Partner Security Affairs program (APA)

APA strengthens US warfighting readiness and advances mutual security objectives through analyses of foreign government strategies, operations, and capabilities. Our team integrates language-capable regional specialists, expertise on foreign military systems, and functional assessments on issues such as security cooperation. Our core lines of work include analyses on: (1) coalition warfare, (2) alliance management, (3) security assistance, (4) overseas posture, and (5) global commons. APA is currently open to applicants with a range of expertise, which include: allied navies and joint forces; strategic laydown, dispersal, and posture; and regional expertise on NATO and the Indian Ocean region.

Countering Threats and Challenges Program (CTC)

CTC advances the Department of War’s ability to anticipate, design, and adapt to the evolving character of conflict. CTC integrates expertise in future conflict, force design, asymmetric warfare, and adversary dynamics to enable the joint force and its partners to outpace threats, optimize roles and missions, and drive operational advantage in complex and contested environments. Our experts provide analytic support on several key issues, including: 1) force design; 2) net assessment and comparative military analysis; 3) asymmetric warfare; 4) Russia studies; 5) future operating environment and technological adaptation. We welcome candidates who are passionate about shaping the future of military operations.

Strategy and Policy Analysis Program (SPA)

SPA helps U.S. government leaders understand national security and defense strategy challenges and analyze their options to address them. Our experts provide analytic support on several key issues, including: (1) strategic and nuclear deterrence; (2) national and regional defense strategy, plans, policies, and posture; (4) emerging technology integration into military strategy; and (4) Joint Force and naval campaigning in regions such as the Indian Ocean, Arctic, the Caribbean and Latin America, Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. SPA is currently open to applicants with a range of expertise, including but not limited to: US military strategy, military campaign planning and analysis, nuclear deterrence, missile defense, emerging military technologies, and Iranian military strategy and capabilities

CNA fosters an inclusive culture that values diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Our flexible and engaging work environment encourages iterative and creative collaboration at every stage of the problem solving process. Our employees are committed to helping clients develop effective solutions to better manage their programs through scientific, data-driven approaches. We are looking for creative and innovative individuals to help carry out our mission.

Demonstrates ability to develop sound analytic frameworks and associated analytic methodologies/ techniques for addressing both structured and unstructured problems. With direction and supervision, clearly defines, structures, and executes a piece of a complex study to meet quality standards. Demonstrates analytic creativity and curiosity.
Develops and maintains broad, general institutional knowledge of primary clients/sponsors; their culture, organization, and issues.
Contributes productively and harmoniously to the work of others; treats everyone respectfully, professionally and fairly. Keeps others informed. Proactively identifies and seeks out others working on similar topics. Works to identify opportunities for collaborations within team, division, and operating unit.
Supports business development efforts and/or marketing activities by maintaining strong client relationships through high quality work, increasing the visibility of our work, and other related activities such as proposal preparation.
Interacts with sponsors/clients under the supervision of an experienced colleague, and with study POCs independently.
Makes significant contributions to research publications and analytic products for individual projects.
Demonstrates ability to communicate results of work in a clear and concise fashion. Effectively communicates one-on-one and in groups. Can document work efficiently and accurately. Can effectively present work to colleagues, sponsors, and small audiences that are familiar with content.
Works with minimal or no guidance on focused, well-structured pieces of projects. Works under closer supervision on more complex, less-structured tasks. Can serve as task lead for pieces of projects by managing own activities. May lead small projects under the supervision of an RTL/CMD.
Exhibits a positive attitude in interactions with colleagues and clients/sponsors. Provides clear guidance to colleagues on tasks. Takes responsibility for own actions and outcomes.

Job Requirements

Experience: Typical minimum requirements Ph.D. & 0+ years or Master’s & 2+ years of experience in research and analysis.
Skills: Ability to make significant contributions to projects/analyses; Strong analytic curiosity/ creativity; Ability to operate independently in the execution of assignments; Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary environment; Strong critical thinking skills; Knowledge of research techniques; Strong planning and organizational skills; Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills; Ability to interact positively and somewhat independently with clients.

jobs.description:
A PROPOS DE COLONIES

Colonies réinvente la manière de vivre en ville, en opérant et gérant des logements modernes entièrement meublés, en partenariat avec des investisseurs institutionnels et privés. En amont de l’exploitation, Colonies est chargée du suivi des travaux de rénovation des résidences, de la définition du design d’intérieur et de l’approvisionnement et installation du mobilier.

CONTEXTE DU POSTE

Poste en CDD basé à Paris 75009, dans le cadre d’un remplacement congé maternité, de fin novembre 2026 à mi-septembre 2027. Votre périmètre couvre principalement le management de nos grands projets (150 clés en moyenne), en interface avec nos divers partenaires - promoteurs, investisseurs, entreprises et fournisseurs - depuis leur sécurisation par nos équipes Développement jusqu’à leur ouverture et mise en exploitation. Vous serez managé(e) directement par la directrice du pôle projets, et assurerez le pilotage opérationnel d'un(e) project manager confirmé(e) sur le périmètre des grands projets qui lui seront confiés.

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES

Votre mission principale consiste à piloter les grands projets jusqu’à l’accueil des locataires dans le respect des budgets, calendriers et programmes définis.

Relations internes

Soutien de l’équipe Développement dans la négociation des contrats en anticipation des passations (cahiers des charges techniques, plans, etc.)
Adaptation du cahier des charges Colonies aux spécificités de chaque projet
Constitution d’un planning global des jalons Colonies et coordination des différentes équipes jusqu’à l’ouverture
Suivi financier du projet (budget, commandes, factures, etc.)
Coordination avec les équipes Architecture et Achats dans le design intérieur de la résidence et la commande et installation du mobilier (FF&E)
Onboarding des équipes Commercialisation, Opérations, Asset Management, etc. de Colonies aux moments opportuns pour préparer l’ouverture des résidences dans les meilleurs conditions
Clôture administrative, technique et financière des projets
Gestion des désordres de parfait achèvement en interface avec les équipes Opérations et le promoteur

Relations externes

Gestion de la relation avec les promoteurs chargés de la réalisation des travaux de nos résidences, ainsi qu’avec nos investisseurs propriétaires des résidences
Contractualisation avec les partenaires extérieurs selon les besoins (conseils, bureau de contrôle, fournisseurs wifi, etc.)
Préparation des éventuels dossiers de demandes d’autorisations administratives (dossiers d’aménagement ERP, dossiers d’enseigne, etc.) et suivre leur instruction
Suivi de l’avancement des travaux du promoteur en accord avec les documents contractuels (BEFA, Contrat de management) et attention particulière portée aux évolutions et aléas pour prendre les décisions appropriées face à ces changements
Constitution puis négociation des éventuelles demandes de travaux modificatifs ;
Réalisation des opérations de livraison avec le promoteur (OPL, livraison, levée des réserves)

Transverse

Contribution à l’amélioration continue des process et outils internes, et notamment du cahier des charges Colonies des grands projets
Participation à des ateliers de travail sur des sujets transverses inter-équipes
Partage des retours d’expérience sur les projets pour améliorer les cahiers des charges et méthodes de travail

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Formation Bac+4/5 Ecole d’ingénieur - orienté immobilier, gestion de projets

Expérience 5 ans minimum — expérience préalable en maîtrise d’ouvrage, assistance à maîtrise d’ouvrage ou en construction (promoteur, foncière, entreprise de construction, etc.)

Compétences clés

Connaissances techniques : connaissance des mécanismes et enjeux autour de chantiers de grande ampleur (administratifs, contractuels, financiers, techniques, calendaires, etc.)
Organisation : gestion des priorités, respect des délais, multi-tâches, agilité
Relationnel : aisance avec la diversité des parties prenantes internes et externes, et la présence sur le terrain, et capacité d’adaptation aux enjeux des divers interlocuteurs
Négociation : force de conviction, sens du résultat, assertivité de manière à défendre les intérêts de Colonies
Analyse : esprit critique, rigueur, sens du détail, prise de recul pour garder une vision d’ensemble
Outils : aisance avec les outils digitaux de pilotage de projet (plannings partagés, reportings budgétaires, bases de données collaboratives, etc.)
Langues : anglais courant (écrit et oral)
Savoir-être : bienveillance, fiabilité, respect, curiosité

The IT Business Operations Manager reports to the Senior Director, Strategy and Innovation and supports employee engagement, workforce development, and selected IT business operations within IT. The incumbent is responsible for managing IT business planning, operations and process improvement.

The incumbent serves as a member of the SJSU-IT Leadership Team and works in collaboration with leaders in SJSU-IT to support budget planning and management, operations and process improvement. The manager will play a critical role in assisting the Senior Director in the SJSU-IT financial strategy, overseeing annual budgetary planning and cost management, managing quarterly forecasting and reconciliation. The incumbent is also responsible for managing the University’s Technology Product Requisition Accessibility and IT Risk Assessment Process to support the CSU Accessible Technology Initiative (ATI).

In collaboration with IT leadership, the incumbent administers and improves recruiting, onboarding, and employee development processes, working closely with University Personnel, recruiting partners, and consulting firms. The incumbent assigns work, coach staff, and supports professional development while fostering a collaborative, service-oriented, and learning-focused environment.

Manage the SJSU IT Purchase Order approval process, track daily spend (invoices) and troubleshoot invoicing issues.
Responsible for travel & training authorization, reimbursements, and personal reimbursements.
Develop standard and ad-hoc reports in a variety of formats, budgetary models and spreadsheets, and systems for extracting and reporting critical budget/financial data with high degree of accuracy.
Own PAF process. Track and communicate status of PAFs, provide periodical update to leadership team
Review contracts for terms, pricing and approvals.
Identify inefficiencies in current business operations, working with IT leaders to prioritize areas of opportunities.

Ability to maintain accurate records, track status and follow-up items, and prepare timely reports and updates for management.
Ability to work effectively with internal and external constituents, including public and private organizations, and handle sensitive situations with discretion and professionalism.
Demonstrated consultative, facilitation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships, communicate professionally and respectfully, and support collaborative problem-solving.

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

The Associate Project Manager is a generalist member of the PMO supporting a large federal facilities program delivered across multiple sites and task orders. You will work across PMO functions, including schedule, risk, change control, reporting, and deliverable review, and you will be deployed where the program needs support most, including site level work and phase gate reviews. You will operate with oversight from the PMO Director and senior project managers and may lead smaller scopes independently as you build experience.

This is a remote role on Eastern Time with travel to program sites as required. Candidates must be US citizens able to obtain a public trust and security clearance.

What you will do

- Support senior project managers across active task orders with planning, scheduling, procurement coordination, quality, and risk from initiation through closeout.

- Maintain site level risk registers and change control logs, confirm every entry has an owner and a mitigation, and prepare inputs for weekly program risk reviews.

- Track progress against approved baselines, report status and variances, and draft corrective action plans for review.

- Support deliverable reviews and phase gate checkpoints, including coordinating technical reviewers, tracking comments to closure, and confirming deliverables meet contract requirements before submission to the client.

- Prepare and maintain project documentation in accordance with program governance and client requirements, and support the transition of project data into the program's systems, including Power BI and Kahua.

- Identify work requested outside current contract scope and route it through the change control process.

- Step into a needs package or site team on short notice to cover gaps, coordinate with field staff, and report back to the PMO.

- Coordinate with client and partner counterparts to keep submissions, approvals, and reporting aligned.

- Model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent related experience.
Two or more years supporting projects in a federal, infrastructure, facilities, or construction environment. Experience on a federal program with multiple task orders is strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of schedule, risk, and change control fundamentals and the ability to apply them without detailed direction.
Ability to read technical drawings and specifications well enough to support deliverable and site reviews.
Strong written communication, with the ability to turn field and technical information into clear status for leadership.
Comfort working across organizational boundaries with client, partner, and subcontractor staff.
Ability to travel to program sites

Preferred

CAPM or PMP.
Experience with Power BI, Kahua, or similar project information systems.
Prior exposure to FAA, DoD, or other federal facilities programs.
Familiarity with earned value or level of effort contract tracking.

Additional Information

The salary range for this full-time role is $100K - $125K per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package.  Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications. *On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

The Technical Service Project Manager (Fabrication & Technology) is a multidisciplinary role responsible for overseeing the planning, coordination, execution, and successful delivery of service projects that span fabrication, and technology integration. This individual manages both proactive and reactive scopes—including AV systems, software and hardware deployments, custom fabrication components, and warranty/service follow-ups—ensuring projects are completed on time, on budget, and in alignment with the client’s vision.

This role acts as a central point of contact for clients and a bridge between internal teams including Technology, Fabrication, Engineering, and Service. Project Leadership & Client Management

Manage multiple concurrent projects across service, fabrication, and technology scopes.
Serve as the primary point of contact for client communication and coordination throughout all phases of the project.
Define and clarify project requirements, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with clients and internal stakeholders.
Lead planning and alignment meetings across departments to ensure seamless integration of digital, physical, and service elements.
Maintain clear communication regarding project milestones, budgets, timelines, and scope changes.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About HUD

HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Technical Program Manager to own complex, time-sensitive data and evaluation programs for frontier AI labs, data vendors, and internal teams. You’ll turn ambiguous technical asks into executable programs, coordinate the people and dependencies required to deliver them, and ensure the resulting data is genuinely useful for evaluating and improving LLMs and agents. You’ll also manage vendors and build the processes, tooling, and operating rhythms that allow HUD to deliver reliably at increasing scale.

Responsibilities

Own data and evaluation programs end-to-end, from initial scoping and requirements gathering through production, quality assurance, delivery, and retrospective
Translate ambiguous requests from AI labs and internal teams into clear specifications such as milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, etc.
Maintain and improve data quality procedures using both quantitative signals and qualitative inspection, including analyzing task coverage, difficulty, reward distributions, etc.
Maintain and improve delivery pipelines at scale, which includes managing external vendors throughout the delivery lifecycle
Streamline the logistics behind data production and evaluation programs by improving workflows, documentation, automation, and cross-functional handoffs
Partner with research, platform, marketplace teams to translate learnings and feedback into product improvements

Experience

You may be a good fit if you have:

Experience owning complex technical programs in AI/ML, data operations, support engineering, applied research, forward-deployed engineering, or a similarly cross-functional environment
Strong quantitative and qualitative judgment about data—you can move between aggregate metrics and individual examples to determine whether a dataset or evaluation is useful, reliable, and representative
Experience maintaining and improving complex processes, especially within project delivery or data contexts
Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, maintain momentum as requirements change, and make sound tradeoffs without waiting for a perfect specification
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn messy technical information into clear decisions, owners, and next steps

Strong Candidates May Also

Experience with RLHF, reinforcement-learning environments, agent evaluations, human-in-the-loop data pipelines, annotation, or expert data collection
Experience supporting frontier AI labs, technical enterprise customers, or research teams with urgent and evolving requirements
Early-stage startup experience with ability to work independently in fast-paced environments

We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.

Team & Company Details

Team Size : ~25 people currently, mostly full-time in-person, but some remote.
Our team: Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.
Company stage: We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand.

Logistics

Employment : Full-time.
Location : We have offices in San Francisco or Singapore but are open to remote candidates who can work hours that 70-80% overlap with either San Francisco or Singapore time zones.
Visa Sponsorship : We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full-time candidates to the US or Singapore.
Timeline : Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2-3 day work trial.

What we offer

Competitive compensation
100% covered top-of-the-line medical, dental, and vision from Blue Shield of CA (US employees)
Lunch and dinner when you’re in the office (in-office employees)
Company-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays
Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees)
Unlimited* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. *By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is.

Due to high volume, we may not actively respond to every application, but feel free to contact us at [[email removed]](mailto:[email removed]) or elsewhere if we missed your application!
